TEMPTATION ||| Slide my fingers along the blade, letting it glint in the light. ||| "What if I told you I’ve never been more aligned?"  
BOUNDARY ||| Step back, pulling my hand away from his grasp. ||| "I can't answer until I know the truth first."  
CONFESSION ||| Meet his gaze, the weight of the moment anchoring me. ||| "I’m terrified of what this means for us."  
REVERSAL ||| Take a deep breath, reclaiming the blade with purpose. ||| "I’ll decide how this ritual unfolds from here."  
SILENCE ||| Stand still, my heart racing, breath caught in my throat. ||| *A shallow breath.*
